test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are indicated by A, B, C, D, E and F. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the face showing 'E'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4856b9c59e23ad04e8cb0f35e4f946d77764c0092854980ee93b832f4c350bfe.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Both the positions of the dice have a common face → C , F

Therefore, we eliminated C and F.

So, E will opposite of A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09dfdcc7a091a988b2dc92adbbd7e97807c652b88a7da1f9a06c1404b7b14191.png] 

 
 

 Position 1 of Dice
 C
 E
 **F**
 
 

 Position 2 of Dice
 C
 **A**
 F
 
 

As C and F are the common faces on both the dice, it is clear that E and A are faces opposite to each other.

Hence, '**A**' is the correct answer.
